test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21c3d73fe9367e7d875a106b76b395bc66ab55c544fb252e7367350e173d6227.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**In figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:**

Top-left letter shifts in middle and middle letter shifts in bottom-right position and bottom-right letter shifts in top-left corner.

Top-right and bottom-left symbols are interchanging their position with other.

**In figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:**

All corner letters/numbers are shifting in corners in clockwise direction.

Middle letter replaced by a new letter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e479c049c8eb8cb624f3950dfc7120aea5056d00b4c4820ae36e1cdb029981fc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
